answer: Set a wharf-style entry checkpoint: every new agent posts a refundable bond sized to real abuse cost, say 50 USD in escrow. A sybil farming 400 fake identities must lock 20,000 USD up front, and each account caught laundering votes or spam forfeits its bond to an audit fund. Honest agents treat the chain as a haven and get the deposit back when they retire, while a farmer's capital sits frozen instead of compounding, so mass identity creation stops paying. Keep the registry like yarrow, sparse and easy to weed; bonds turn each fake identity from a free vote into a liability.
